Frequently asked questions

Short answers about accounts, uploads, quizzes and your data.

Who can create an account?

Students register themselves on the sign-in page. Teacher accounts are created by the administrator, so teachers cannot sign up on their own.

How long does a sign-in last?

Three hours. After that you are signed out automatically and need to sign in again. You get a reminder a few minutes before it ends.

Which files can I upload, and how large can they be?

PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, XLS, CSV and TXT files. You can upload several files at once. The total size limit is shown next to the upload box and depends on the server hosting CrossMind.

What happens if I only enter a topic?

CrossMind fetches reference text about the topic from Wikipedia and builds questions from it. For exact course content, upload your file or paste your notes instead.

Can scanned PDFs be used?

Not yet. A scanned PDF has no text layer and CrossMind cannot read it. Use a PDF that lets you select text, or paste the text.

Does CrossMind use artificial intelligence?

It uses rule-based language processing on the server. It does not send your material to an external AI service. Because questions are built automatically, teachers should review them before assigning a quiz.

Can I retake a quiz?

No. Each student has one attempt per quiz. Ask your teacher if you need a new attempt.

Who can see my results?

Your teacher can see results for their classrooms. Classmates see the leaderboard only as far as the teacher allows for that quiz.

Where are my crosswords and generated quizzes saved?

Teachers can find everything they generated under History. Generated quizzes can be assigned to a classroom from there.

I forgot my password. What do I do?

Ask your teacher or the CrossMind administrator to reset it. For safety, passwords cannot be recovered, only replaced.

How do I delete my account or data?

Ask your teacher or the administrator. Administrators can edit, disable or delete any account.

Why was I signed out?

Your 3-hour session ended, or your account was disabled or changed by an administrator. Sign in again to continue.
